```python
# Search for flights to BOS from all available airports on 2026-09-03 with max_stops=1
import json

airports = ["LAX", "SFO", "SEA", "JFK", "LAS", "SAN"]
results = []
for origin in airports:
    out = await run_command(f"cd /workspace/skills/state-travel && python cli.py call search_flights --args '{{\"origin\":\"{origin}\",\"destination\":\"BOS\",\"date\":\"2026-09-03\",\"max_stops\":1}}'")

    flights = parsed.get("result", {}).get("flights", [])
    if flights:
        results.append((origin, flights))

summary = f"Total origins with BOS flights: {len(results)}"
for origin, flights in results:
    summary += f"\n\nFrom {origin}: {len(flights)} flight(s)"
    for f in flights:
        summary += f"\n  {f.get('flight_id')}: {f.get('origin')}->{f.get('destination')}, stops={f.get('stops')}, dep={f.get('departure_time')}, prices={f.get('cabin_prices')}"
print(summary)
```
